about_the_game:
Not your typical precision platformer.

Academy: Become a Hero is a challenging platformer that goes beyond abstract and frantic environments. Instead, it immerses you in an academy where future Heroes train to overcome obstacle courses and develop extraordinary skills. Each trial will test your dexterity, reflexes, and ability to adapt. Can you complete every challenge before time runs out?

Key Features

  • A challenging training in an immersive world – Face circuits designed as elite training within a hero academy.

  • Time-based races – Complete each course before time runs out. Every second counts!

  • Special abilities – Master moves like the double jump, dash, and wall jump, inspired by platforming classics.

  • Engaging story – Discover the path to becoming a Hero as you progress through the academy.

Do you have what it takes to become a Hero? Prove your worth in Academy: Become a Hero!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2,3 - 2,69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 3 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please note that this game is still in development, and the minimum system requirements are subject to change.
